title: Golden Kamuy
synopsis: In the early twentieth century, Russo-Japanese War veteran Saichi “Immortal” Sugimoto scratches out a meager existence during the postwar gold rush in the wilderness of Hokkaido. When he stumbles across a map to a fortune in hidden Ainu gold, he sets off on a treacherous quest to find it. But Sugimoto is not the only interested party, and everyone who knows about the gold will kill to possess it! Faced with the harsh conditions of the northern wilderness, ruthless criminals and rogue Japanese soldiers, Sugimoto will need all his skills and luck—and the help of an Ainu girl named Asirpa—to survive. (Source: VIZ Media) Note: Won the 9th Manga Taisho Award in 2016 and the 22nd Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize in 2018. Nominated for the 20th and 21st Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize and the 40th Kodansha Manga Awards in 2016.

title: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
titleEnglish: Trapped at Home With the Male Leads
synopsis: After being reincarnated into the body of a novel's wealthy heiress, Cherry Sinclair quickly realizes that the world is coming to an end, but she’s determined to survive the apocalypse, no matter what. Using the money that came with this new life, she devises a plan to create a shelter to hide from the monsters. What she does not expect, however, is for the male leads of the novel to also end up in the same house! Will all of them be able to work together to survive in this chaos? (Source: Tapas)

title: Manga Lover
synopsis: While conducting research in the back alleys of the Shinjuku Toho Building (To-yoko), third-year manga editor Yanai hears the voice of Misumi, who wants to show him her manga. Having previously focused solely on producing successful works, Yanai finds himself captivated by Misumi's rough drafts, and decides to guide her to a successful serialization. However, Misumi has neither home nor money... This is the story of a young creator and editor rising through the ranks, inspiring the world through their manga. (Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Mr Mini Mart
synopsis: Shy Nakaba has been a shut-in ever since gossip at school destroyed his reputation. But when his mom snags him a job to help him break out of his shell, he’s forced to face a co-worker who knows a thing or two about courage and commitment! Can Nakaba stand tall and speak up for what he truly wants? Mr. Mini Mart serves up a sweet-and-salty story filled with brave confessions and bold crushes! Will the past catch up to a boy who wants nothing more than to hide away forever? Or will the future finally shine with the promise of brand-new beginnings? (Source: Juné) Included one-shot: Shounen Scrub (Youthful Love)
